title: Why this arm
caption: At each round, each arm scores its estimated mean plus an exploration bonus. The played arm (orange) has the highest score. Use the slider or Play.

title: Pulls over time
caption: Share of the pulls of each arm per time window. Exploration first, then the best arms take over.

title: Regret per arm
caption: Where the regret comes from: the gap of each arm times its number of pulls (pseudo-regret).
